requirements.text: Minimum of 3 years of professional software engineering experience in a product-oriented, live production environment.

Minimum of 3 years of experience designing, building, and maintaining production-quality back-end services and microservices using languages such as Go, Node.js/TypeScript, or Python, including REST and/or GraphQL APIs, relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and scalable distributed systems.
Minimum of 3 years of experience with AWS or another major public cloud platform, including hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

Minimum of 2 years of experience developing or supporting enterprise SaaS products or platforms, including authentication, application security, system integrations, and troubleshooting production issues affecting reliability, availability, or performance.
Minimum of 1 year of experience using AI-assisted software development tools for coding, debugging, technical investigation, testing, or code review.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering (or related field) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience.
Ability to independently drive technical work from requirements and design through production delivery.
Ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, Design, Operations, and other cross-functional teams.
Strong technical problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States.
